real_task: Determine whether an independently motivated current-summary update after Session 124 provides a second consumer for the gate-derived wording practice.
observed_problem: Session 123 removed one stale fixed session number, while Session 124 could not evaluate recurrence because no independent later summary update existed. Repeated evaluation without a consumer would turn policy work into its own project.
baseline: The next independently motivated tracked STATE or ROADMAP update after Session 124, if one exists, assessed for stale future-session assertions before applying the gate-derived wording practice.
hypothesis: A comparable natural later summary update using gate-derived wording contains at least one fewer stale future-session assertion while preserving its operational next action and human-review boundary.
metric: known stale future-session assertions in a natural later current-summary update
minimum_useful_effect: At least 1 fewer stale assertion, with the operational next action and distutils human-review boundary preserved.
quality_control: The summary update must be a tracked descendant of Session 124 created for an independent workflow need. This evaluation's own STATE, ROADMAP, decision, session, ledger, claim or checkpoint edits do not count as a consumer.
overhead: Count mandatory startup reading, branch and PR audit, gate/checkpoint/coverage, evidence review, descendant inspection, reporting, tests, site build, checkpoint maintenance and publication.
stop_condition: If origin/main has no post-Session-124 natural current-summary update, record a second inconclusive evaluation and park the family. Do not create a summary, stale assertion, checker or coordination service solely for comparison, and do not cross the distutils human-review boundary.

result.finding: There is no tracked descendant of Session 124 and therefore no independently motivated later current-summary update. The comparison remains unavailable.

decision_reason: This is the second unavailable evaluation after Session 123's positive result. Park the family until a genuinely new contradiction or independently motivated comparable summary update appears; do not manufacture a consumer or add a checker.
failures: The initial post-clone command ran git status from the parent scratch directory rather than the new checkout and exited 128. Re-running the read-only inspection in repo125 succeeded; no repository state was changed.
limitations: Two unavailable comparisons support stopping work, not a claim that the wording practice succeeds or fails. No claim about prevention, task success, time, tokens, agent performance or LLM improvement follows.
